answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 18 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 320 identities costs 320 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The nectar of the design is public, the ripple of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the wander of honest work is what finally pays.
